description: This PHP file defines the class SugarRestJSON that implements a JSON-based REST protocol for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It handles encoding responses to JSON, serving API calls, and generating fault responses.

classes.name: SugarRestJSON
classes.description: A class implementing REST protocol using JSON for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, with methods for response generation, serving requests, and fault handling.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Encodes input data as JSON and outputs it, supporting JSONP if requested, or outputs a fault if faultObject is set.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Handles incoming API requests by invoking specified methods on the implementation object and returning results.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Sets the faultObject for the response, which will be used to generate a fault response.

methods.name: generateFaultResponse
methods.description: Outputs a JSON-encoded fault response based on a provided SoapError object.
